name: Tulehu
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Checked: Collins 1983, The historical relationships of the languages of Central Maluku (read via ANU repository) - mentions Tulehu but gives no Tulehu stress statement; no grammar of Tulehu located.

sources.citation: OLAC resource page for tlu (language-archives.org, the Internet Archive 2025-12-04); en/id Wikipedia 'Tulehu language'; potrettulehu.blogspot.com community 'Kamus Bahasa Tulehu' (2016/2018).
sources.note: OLAC lists no language descriptions beyond Glottolog/Ethnologue/LINGUIST entries; Wikipedia phoneme table cites Musgrave 2015 only; community word list has no pronunciation/stress notes.

sources.citation: [ARBITRER] 2021. Pelestarian bahasa Tulehu berbasis sinergisitas masyarakat dan sekolah di Kecamatan Salahutu, Maluku Tengah. ARBITRER: Jurnal Pendidikan Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia 3(1):447-456. doi 10.30598/arbitrervol3no1hlm447-456
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sociolinguistic; only says young learners' main difficulty is pronunciation 'terkait dengan unsur-unsur suprasegmental.. pelafalan dan intonasinya' (p.455); no rule.

sources.citation: Musgrave, Simon. 2015. Placename narratives and identity in north east Ambon Island. Handout, 13-ICAL, Academia Sinica, Taipei, 20 July 2015, 7 pp. (Internet Archive copy).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p.1 'Typology' gives only the phoneme inventory (5 vowels; p t k glottal stop s; voiced stops in loans; m n (ng) r l w j); no statement on stress. Source of the en.wikipedia phoneme table.

sources.citation: Ewing, Michael C. 2010. Agentive alignment in Central Maluku languages. PL 618:119-142 (sec. 5.2 Sou Amana Teru); Hajek, John. 2010. Towards a phonological overview of the vowel and consonant systems of East Nusantara. PL 618:25-46.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Sou Amana Teru/Tulehu stress (Ewing: pronoun paradigm and alignment; Hajek: segment inventories, Sou Amana Teru not treated).

sources.citation: Musgrave, Simon. 2010. Reduced pronouns and arguments in Sou Amana Teru, Ambon. In Ewing & Klamer (eds.), East Nusantara: typological and areal analyses (Pacific Linguistics 618), 143-164. Canberra: ANU. (open access, hdl 1885/146766)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: held in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL5051.E28 2010); the library holds the journal volume but the item itself was not found; ask your own library for a scan or interlibrary loan
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL5051 .E28 2010
sources.note: Nothing. Background section (p.144) and a footnote on the glottal stop only; clitic analysis is morphosyntactic, no prosodic criteria or stress rule given.

sources.citation: Musgrave, Simon. 2005. Possession in Souw Amana Teru: internally and externally motivated change. Monash University Linguistics Papers 4(1):65-81 (figshare doi 10.26180/5063590.v1).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.citation: Collins, James T. 1983. The historical relationships of the languages of Central Maluku, Indonesia. Pacific Linguistics D-47. Canberra: ANU.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Tulehu placed in the Ambon subgroup (with Hitu, Laha, Seit-Kaitetu; 'reportedly spoken in Liang, Tulehu and Tenga-tenga'); stress rules stated only for Hoamoal/West Piru Bay languages and Asilulu (penultimate); nothing on Tulehu stress.

sources.citation: Mukhtar, Adi Syaiful. 2017. Fungsi dan Bentuk Kelas Kata Bahasa Tulehu. Ambon: Kantor Bahasa Provinsi Maluku. 72 pp. ISBN 978-602-60859-8-6.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: open copy online, not downloaded; access check: not located online or in the libraries checked; the open copy could not be downloaded when a reader tried
sources.note: Only modern Indonesian monograph on Tulehu; word-class study but Kantor Bahasa volumes usually open with a short 'fonologi/ejaan' section that may state tekanan kata.

sources.citation: Musgrave, Simon. 2012. Grammatical Relations in Sou Amana Teru. Unpublished ms., 8 pp. (Glottolog ref 575304); plus any unpublished Sou Amana Teru sketch/field phonology from Musgrave's 2003-2006 Tulehu documentation project (Monash).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Musgrave is the only linguist to have documented the language in depth; an unpublished sketch or field phonology would be the authoritative modern source; could also be asked directly.

sources.citation: Totobuang (Kantor Bahasa Maluku journal) and Kantor Bahasa Maluku research reports on bahasa Tulehu (e.g. any 'Fonologi Bahasa Tulehu'), 2013-2025.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Kantor Bahasa Maluku staff have worked on Tulehu (Mukhtar 2017); a phonology article, if it exists, would be here.
